Name: Blahaj Blast
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Blahaj Blast[/b] is a new ranged weapon that shoots a sharknado at your enemies. (Max 4 per second.)

Available at Willy's shop for 10k or by an easter egg.

[spoiler]By changing your gender at the Wizard's appearance shrine.[/spoiler]

Thanks Sunstream7 from the East Scarpe server for the blahaj sprite!

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
